capabilities: Chat with cloud and local LLMs in a side panel
Index the vault with local or cloud embeddings for semantic search
Run terminal CLI agents with read-only or edit modes
Execute agent tasks with diff review and approval cards
Serve and connect external MCP servers and tools
disambiguation: Not only a chat panel; it also runs terminal CLI agents and exposes vault tools as an MCP server.
extras: Many features are Desktop only: local LLMs, terminal CLI agents, external MCP client/server, and built-in offline embeddings; mobile needs a cloud embedding model for RAG. API keys are stored via Obsidian SecretStorage. Agent file edits use inline diff review with approval cards and automatic overwrite backups; the README advises monitoring agent operations closely. Debug logs may contain chat transcripts. A donation link is included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with AI models over vault context, run semantic search, or let agents and external AI tools read and edit notes.
